ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to 25% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixel distribution across visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity (white) clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes; the viewer-right lobe exhibits a larger, more contiguous high-intensity region than the viewer-left lobe; central and proximal areas are dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior pixel angle of 80-85 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Jagged, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 3 and 10 pixels; higher frequency of smaller serrations concentrated near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from distal tips to the median notch; outer distal boundaries are markedly convex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small (4-6 pixel diameter) circular high-contrast white spots detected within the distal high-intensity patch of the viewer-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned linear white streaks (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across both lobes; at least 12 individual linear disruptions are visible crossing the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear scarring (rake marks) across the entirety of the visible ventral surface; small irregular notch present on the extreme viewer-left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique small protrusion or skin tag at the terminal tip of the viewer-left fluke lobe.
